mentions.name: Achira: Japan Offline Guide
mentions.description: A compass app for finding konbini (convenience stores) while walking around Tokyo. It shows a compass face with brand and distance, replacing the heavy process of opening a map app, switching to a Japanese keyboard, and typing 'konbini' to reliably find a store. Basic konbini hunting is free and the app works offline first, with stamp-book style collection features plus optional PRO features such as more stats, filtering, and additional store types coming soon.
mentions.problem: Reliably finding a konbini while out in Tokyo required opening a map app, changing to a Japanese keyboard, and typing 'konbini', which the author found heavy while ambling around.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made a simple wee Konbini compass* app for whenever I'm ambling around Tokyo so I no longer have to go through the (_so heavy_) process of opening a map app, changing to jp keyboard and typing `konbini` to reliably find something.

Instead it's just a compass face, with brand and distance.

It's free for basic konbini hunting (has probably most of the stored in Japan), and is offline first. So maybe it's useful to other folk?? (I hope so!)
